methodology.section_mapping: Regex-based from QuestionID per pack naming convention
methodology.deduplication: Pack A uses dual-block architecture — QuestionID deduplicated, metadata block CognitiveLevel used
methodology.cognitive_level_threshold: At or below Apply = Remember, Understand, Apply (candidates for upgrade to Analyze/Evaluate)

A.roi_rationale: Heavy calculations and judgment scenarios (ASC topics, discontinued ops, revenue recognition) — strong candidates for Analyze/Evaluate rewrite. Many Apply items can become "recommend the treatment" or "evaluate the CFO's position" type questions. Pool: 375 items, 346 at/below Apply (92%). Certified pool exposure: 346 items in learner pool at/below Apply.

B.roi_rationale: Budgeting scenarios with multiple variables, cash collection schedules, and forecast revision decisions naturally support Evaluate-level "which budget approach should management recommend" items. Pool: 500 items, 480 at/below Apply (96%). Certified pool exposure: 480 items in learner pool at/below Apply.

C.roi_rationale: Variance analysis, responsibility accounting, and KPI evaluation are inherently Evaluate domains. Many Apply items can be reframed as "identify the root cause" or "recommend corrective action." Pool: 500 items, 454 at/below Apply (91%). Certified pool exposure: 454 items in learner pool at/below Apply.

D.roi_rationale: CVP, relevant costing, make-or-buy decisions, and transfer pricing are classic Analyze/Evaluate topics. Several Apply items can become multi-step decision scenarios. Pool: 375 items, 327 at/below Apply (87%). Certified pool exposure: 327 items in learner pool at/below Apply.

E.roi_rationale: COSO framework application, fraud risk assessment, and control deficiency evaluation are natural Evaluate domains. Many Understand items can become "assess the control weakness" scenarios. Pool: 415 items, 249 at/below Apply (60%). Certified pool exposure: 249 items in learner pool at/below Apply.

F.roi_rationale: Large pool (375 items, 326 at/below Apply) but Technology and Analytics items are harder to upgrade cognitively. recommendation: HIGHEST PRIORITY: Section B (480 candidates, 480 in learner pool); Section C (454 candidates, 454 in learner pool); Section A (346 candidates, 346 in learner pool); Section D (327 candidates, 327 in learner pool). SECONDARY: Section F (326 candidates); Section E (249 candidates). Begin with the section having the most Certified items at/below Apply to maximize learner impact. For each rewrite target, preserve the underlying accounting concept but elevate the question stem from "calculate/identify" to "recommend/evaluate/assess." Use business-scenario framing with named companies and stakeholders.

domain_viability_notes.A: HIGH viability — financial reporting has many judgment scenarios (ASC 205-20, 606, 842, 326). Convert "calculate depreciation" to "evaluate which depreciation method best reflects asset usage."
domain_viability_notes.B: HIGH viability — budgeting chain (sales → production → materials → cash) supports multi-step Analyze scenarios and "recommend the budget approach" Evaluate items.
domain_viability_notes.C: MEDIUM-HIGH viability — variance analysis and performance evaluation naturally support Analyze/Evaluate. "Calculate the variance" → "Diagnose the root cause and recommend corrective action."
domain_viability_notes.D: HIGH viability — CVP, relevant costing, make-or-buy, special orders, and transfer pricing are decision-oriented. Many Apply items are one step away from Analyze.
domain_viability_notes.E: MEDIUM viability — COSO framework can support Evaluate ("assess control deficiency severity"), but many items are definition-based (5 components, 17 principles).
domain_viability_notes.F: LOW viability — Technology terms, data governance definitions, and cybersecurity frameworks are inherently Remember/Understand. Converting to Analyze/Evaluate risks drifting into Part 2 IT governance territory.

next_steps: Run section-level deep scan to identify specific QIDs at/below Apply within the highest-ROI section. Cross-reference with MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md for topic distribution. Produce per-item cognitive upgrade recommendation report.
